section: Iterate - change: accept both proposal header forms (W1)
title: decisions-proposed.md accepts the daemon header form
context: The leadwright daemon writes '## Proposed <ts> - <key>' with a decisionKey marker and the lead only in a Lead bullet; the WebUI only read '## [<ts>] <lead>', so no real daemon proposal was listed or countersignable.
decision: Parser (server proposed-entry-format.ts + client mirror) accepts both forms; identity stays (timestamp, leadId), lead for daemon form = first Lead bullet after the closing fence; marker travels with its entry; pinned fixture + docs/org-proposed-entry-contract.md.
consequences: Old entries behave unchanged; countersign moves daemon entries once (marker kept as first log body line). Two parsers (server, client) must stay in step with the pinned sample.
rationale: Operator decision 2026-11-23: WebUI tolerant first, leadwright changes header later; smallest change, no new standing mechanism.
rejected: Daemon-only change (leaves existing daemon entries unreadable); shared parser package (rule 7 forbids cross-package imports).
